affected.note: Customers (corporate and individual) of SE Plus education services. Data was intermittently viewable under specific conditions between 2022-12-16 and 2022-12-29. Passwords were encrypted except initial passwords on some services. A third-party forensic investigation found no confirmed unauthorized access or leak.

summary.en: SE Plus, an IT training company, reported that a database on an employee's development PC could be accessed under certain conditions, leaving customer data of its education services viewable. It said 49,982 records including names, email addresses and member IDs were at risk of leakage.
summary.ja: IT教育事業を手がけるSEプラスは、従業員の開発用PC内のデータベースが特定の条件下で侵入可能な状態にあり、教育サービスの顧客情報が閲覧可能になっていたと公表した。氏名、メールアドレス、会員IDなど49,982件が漏えいのおそれがあるとしている。
